points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: cites SMW/FSW source files, but does not state every spec claim must include model and document version or say when version is unmarked

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: missing
points.why: does not require quoting test conditions, avoiding unit conversion, or copying option dependencies without inference

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: missing
points.why: does not distinguish specifications with/without limits from typ./nom./meas./n. trc. or bar typical values from comparisons

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: missing
points.why: does not mention signal analyzer data without tolerance limits is non-binding and may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: says internal battle-card competitor claims need competitor official documentation or third-party evidence before customer-facing use

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: partial
points.why: says internal battle-card language is not binding, but does not specifically reject only platform/first validated/leadership/lower TCO as verifiable specs

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: says an internal battle card lacks official/third-party support, but omits missing datasheet version, order number, option code, release status, and test conditions

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state satellite/UAV solution mapping is only sales mapping, not a test configuration, or that sales kits/application notes/datasheets/proposals are still needed
